name: High School Summer Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at a children's hospital for seven weeks in summer. You walk patients to appointments, greet families and give small gifts to patients, and help with office work.
who_can_apply: Students who have finished their freshman year of high school and are 15 to 17 years old by the orientation date (June 14 last cycle). The page says no exceptions.
duration: 7 weeks, 16 hours a week in 4 blocks, Monday to Thursday, 112 hours in all
deadline_text: The 2027 dates are not posted. Last cycle, the application opened Jan 26, 2026 at 4 p.m. and closed Feb 2, 2026 at 4 p.m. The program ran June 22 to Aug 6, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply online during the one-week window. Write two short answers (150 words each) and one essay (300 words). Give the emails of two teachers, counselors, coaches or mentors. Then a video interview with a parent, a health screening and a full-day orientation.
notes: The window is only one week, so mark late January on your calendar. This is not job shadowing or an internship, and contact with patients who stay in the hospital is limited. You need full shot records, a TB blood test and a drug and alcohol screening. No weekend shifts. You may not miss more than one week. Questions: Volunteer Resources, 323-361-2317, Volunteers@chla.usc.edu.
